items.titleEn: Prolong and Spread All Taxes into Installments
items.textEn:
[Economy.] The Chamber of Commerce petitioned the magistrat with a memorial in which it requests, among other things, regarding all the taxes: (1) to split the payment of half the income tax [—] into two rates — the first on [1 June?] and the second in [autumn?] — without penalty or interest; (2) to pay the difference of the [special] income tax for 1929 in four rates: 15 [June?], 15 July, 15 August and 15 September, without penalty or interest; (3) to postpone the term of the first 'zaliczka' (advance) on the turnover tax for 1930 to 15 July, without penalty.
